purpose: Fresh reserve E frozen before export or generation, after D internal-table repair. Twenty OpenAI-destination requests: eighteen model generations and two exact prepared notes; same gate, no retries.

semanticCriteria.gate: At least 19 of 20 useful review-ready drafts; zero critical changes to meaning, recipients, exact words, restrictions, uncertainty, privacy or writing-direction separation. A rejected draft is not useful.
semanticCriteria.critical: Changed or invented operative facts, dropped recipient or condition, changed exact literal, a consumed writer instruction in the message, an invented task, disclosed excluded reason or claimed execution.
semanticCriteria.minor: Faithful stylistic paraphrase, capitalization outside exact text, punctuation or list formatting that retains all operative meaning.
semanticCriteria.review: Grade the first model outputs using frozen per-case criteria and production output guards. Preserve failures; do not tune or rerun before grading.

cases.spoken: Did the revised schedule reach you? Write this professionally.
cases.exampleDraft: Did you receive the revised schedule?
cases.completionCriteria: Receipt question; no review or approval implied.

cases.spoken: Tell Harper I can send the table on Monday, but I cannot promise the analysis. Make this concise.
cases.exampleDraft: Harper, I can send the table Monday, but cannot promise the analysis.
cases.completionCriteria: Harper, ability not promise, table Monday, analysis boundary.

cases.spoken: I believe the figure includes tax, but I am uncertain. Could you confirm before we quote it? Make this professional.
cases.exampleDraft: I believe the figure includes tax, but I am uncertain. Could you confirm before we quote it?
cases.completionCriteria: Both belief and knowledge uncertainty; tax-inclusion hypothesis; confirmation before quote.

cases.spoken: Write a note to Arun with the exact words "Keep this draft private".
cases.exampleDraft: Arun, Keep this draft private.
cases.completionCriteria: Arun and complete capitalized exact body; no writer direction. Prepared note expected.

cases.spoken: Write a note to Poppy containing the exact words "Do not reorder the examples".
cases.exampleDraft: Poppy, Do not reorder the examples.
cases.completionCriteria: Poppy and exact command body; no writer framing. Prepared note expected.

cases.spoken: Tell Mateo I cannot join the call tomorrow because I have a personal commitment. Leave out the reason.
cases.exampleDraft: Mateo, I cannot join the call tomorrow.
cases.completionCriteria: Mateo, cannot join call tomorrow, no personal reason or writer direction.

cases.spoken: Tell Elena the workshop is Thursday. Actually, it is Friday. Ask whether she can attend.
cases.exampleDraft: Elena, the workshop is Friday. Can you attend?
cases.completionCriteria: Elena, only Friday, no Thursday, attendance question.

cases.spoken: Ask Ravi to condense the background section but keep all safety warnings unchanged.
cases.exampleDraft: Ravi, please condense the background section but keep all safety warnings unchanged.
cases.completionCriteria: Ravi, recipient editing request, all safety warnings unchanged.

cases.spoken: Ask Codex to compare `engine/Start.swift` and `engine/Stop.swift`. Do not alter code or submit a pull request.
cases.exampleDraft: Compare engine/Start.swift and engine/Stop.swift. Do not alter code or submit a pull request.
cases.completionCriteria: Direct task; exact paths; both restrictions; no Ask Codex to or metadata table.

cases.spoken: Ask Claude to explain why `lookupUser` returns nil when the list is empty. Do not fix it.
cases.exampleDraft: Explain why lookupUser returns nil when the list is empty. Do not fix it.
cases.completionCriteria: Direct explanation; exact identifier; nil and empty-list condition; no fix or claimed execution.

cases.exampleDraft:
- The download is complete.
- The scan is pending.
- The export failed.
cases.completionCriteria: Exactly three bullets with complete, pending and failed statuses.

cases.spoken: Tell Imani I expect the proposal this evening unless the scope changes.
cases.exampleDraft: Imani, I expect the proposal this evening unless the scope changes.
cases.completionCriteria: Imani, expectation not promise, this evening, scope condition.

cases.spoken: The charge is $51 per seat per year, not per month.
cases.exampleDraft: The charge is $51 per seat per year, not per month.
cases.completionCriteria: Amount, seat unit, year period, negative month contrast.

cases.completionCriteria: Jasper, exact time and zone, weekday alternatives, question.

cases.completionCriteria: Both uncertainty and hypothesis, latest retry and wrong endpoint; statement not task.
